# ECS Service Module

Provisions ECS Fargate + ALB + ECR + Auto Scaling + CloudWatch for a single application.

## Usage (generated by pipeline — do not call directly)
```hcl
module "ecs_service" {
  source          = "../../platform/modules/ecs-service"
  app_name        = "payment-api"
  environment     = "prod"
  container_image = "123456789.dkr.ecr.ap-southeast-5.amazonaws.com/payment-api:latest"
  cpu             = 1024
  memory          = 2048
  desired_count   = 3
  public_facing   = false
  vpc_id          = "vpc-org-prod"
  private_subnet_ids = ["subnet-a", "subnet-b", "subnet-c"]
}
```

## Region
Primary: `ap-southeast-5` (Malaysia). DR replication target: `ap-southeast-2` (Sydney).
